# Vendor Assets

This directory contains third-party assets for the ASAGO recommender HTML demo.

## Assets

- **patternfly.css** (2.3 MB)
  - Red Hat PatternFly CSS framework
  - Used for UI component styling and dark/light theme support

- **branding.css** (7 KB)
  - Custom branding styles for ASAGO demo

- **logo.svg** (7 KB)
  - ASAGO project logo

- **view-state.js** is not copied into demo-site. The reference demo does not load it. Add it back only if the front end needs it.

## License

These assets are part of the ASAGO project. Refer to ASAGO's project licensing for usage terms.

Licence note for this copy: PatternFly is MIT-licensed upstream. Confirm that against the version in use.
The root `LICENSE` of the reference repo (`asago-pipeline-demo`) is Apache-2.0, not MIT. Check which licence
applies to `branding.css` and `logo.svg` before any redistribution. This demo is local only.
